d: Spain has been rocked by its first general strike in 14 years, as millions of workers take to the streets over soaring rents, housing shortages and the rising cost of living. Protests turned tense in Madrid, with police deploying pepper spray against demonstrators and clashes reported across several cities. Around 40 arrests and 20 injuries were reported by police as transport, factories and businesses faced major disruptions. With unions demanding urgent action on housing and wages, the nationwide unrest puts fresh pressure on Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez ahead of Spain's November 29…
